summary: Describes a design for carrying IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover (MIH) messages across IP networks. It also covers how a mobile node can discover the mobility services it needs and how to transport the messages securely. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: When your phone moves from one kind of network to another, it needs helpers that tell it where to go. This document explains how the phone finds those helpers and talks to them over the Internet.
